ellie_people_ops: Proposal: mid-cycle review schedule tweak to reduce reviewer spikes. Short ask: ok to run a split-deadline flow with exemptions for small teams? Need sign-off by EOD.

omar_eng_manager: Agree in principle. Define small-team exemption size?

ellie_people_ops: Small teams = 6 or fewer keep single batch. For teams >6: 60% due Day 3, remaining 40% due Day 7.

kai_recruiter: One request: exclude hires with <10 days tenure from early-signal sampling. I'll DM a start-date CSV.

ellie_people_ops: Will exclude new hires. We'll tag early-signal (20%) = customer-facing, recent launch leads, or cross-team owners. Managers can override tags in the sheet.

omar_eng_manager: Can we get APAC-friendly calibration times? last cycle clashed with timezones.

ellie_people_ops: Yes  Signal Check will run twice (07:30 PST and 19:00 PST). Consensus session scheduled after full handbacks.

ops-bot: Reminder configured: Day 2, Day 6, Final. Calendar invites queued.

ellie_people_ops: Ops will also perform 8 random spot-checks per manager pre-calibration and include a 4-point reviewer checklist in reminders (impact, objectives, evidence, score rationale). If no objections by EOD I'll publish and open opt-in for accelerated teams. :white_check_mark:
